about_the_game:
It was supposed to be a simple errand: return a book to the library. But when you're an aspiring adventurer, every quest is an epic quest!

Bravest Coconut is a puzzle adventure about a small white cat in over her head, armed with curiosity, stubbornness, and whatever she can fit in her pockets.

Tambryn Valley is a hand-pixeled world full of places to explore and secrets to be found around every corner. Talk to the locals and poke around where you shouldn't be poking around to unravel the mysterious goings on.

Bravest Coconut is a puzzle game at heart. You'll solve inventory puzzles, dialogue puzzles, environmental brain-teasers, and plenty of surprises that don't fit neatly into any category. Some are tucked into the main story but many more are hidden off the beaten path for anyone stubborn enough to hunt them down.

The valley isn't all friendly faces. Monsters are everywhere but for a brave adventurer such as yourself, that's just a regular Tuesday. And for the less brave adventurers who just want to experience the puzzles, there's a bunch of handy accessibility options to customise your experience.

A playable demo is available right now. Step into Tambryn Valley and see what the fuss is about. And if you like what you find, add Bravest Coconut to your wishlist to be the first to know when the full adventure is ready.

Features

  • A hand-pixeled world full of hidden paths, secrets, and surprises

  • Heaps of puzzles including inventory, dialogue, environmental, and a few that defy description

  • A cast of quirky characters with their own problems, opinions, and questionable advice

  • Simple, fun combat system

  • Full accessibility options: remap input, reduce motion, adjust difficulty of combat or skip it entirely

  • Playable on Windows, macOS, and Linux/Steamdeck

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or greater
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
